items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: Now, every once in a while, Tony would decide that he was the maitre d'.

ctx.x: And you were that impressed by them, even before you were able to get in the places. Yeah. You'd be underage.

As I said earlier, I was lucky because I was a tall kid. Yeah. And I could get in those places. Sometimes when I was maybe 16 years old, I might be able to get past Tony at Lenfance. If he wasn't looking, I could zip in. See, I'd put one of my daddy's suits on and zip in. Now, every once in a while, Tony would decide that he was the maitre d'. I don't know if you remember Tony. I can't think of his last name. But he would come by and check the bar and spot us and throw us out. Ask us to leave. Tony didn't have to…
